title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-09
lineage: Master Reel > cassette > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a sweltering RFK show that delivers solid performances – Box of Rain and a scorching Playing In The Band stand out despite occasional slip‑ups.
ai_review.review: The set was played in brutally hot conditions, yet the band pushed through with notable moments such as a heartfelt Box of Rain and an incendiary Playing In The Barrels. Jerry Garcia has a few missteps but shines on the PITB jam, and the overall sound is clear enough to enjoy, though the heat‑induced fatigue shows up in some sluggish passages.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and note a decent soundboard capture, but there are recurring comments about heat‑related fatigue and occasional mistakes that keep the rating from higher levels.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the mix as nice and clear; no major audio glitches reported, though the heat may have affected perceived energy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon first set (14 songs) performed under extreme heat; the band showed grit, delivering strong jams despite occasional sluggishness.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned having a few screw‑ups but praised his smoky playing on Playing In The Barrels.
band_member_comments.Phil: One reviewer wondered why Phil sang at RFK, implying vocal presence was notable but not specifically evaluated.
